newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: June '96 yr on yr world air cargo growth up 8.5pct.
newsitem.headline: June '96 yr on yr world air cargo growth up 8.5pct.

text.p: Freight and mail traffic handled by 458 airports around the world in June 1996, totalled 4.11 million tonnes, up 8.5 percent on the same month last year, said Geneva-based Airports Council International (ACI).
North America, the biggest of ACI's six cargo-handling regions, reported 2.26 million tonnes of freight traffic, up 12.6 percent on June 1995.
Cargo traffic handled at ACI's Europe member airports totalled 820,780 tonnes, a rise of 2.7 percent.

Airports in the Asia/Pacific region (in which ACI incorporates Indo-China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Japan, Malaysia and Australia), cargo throughput of 761,298 tonnes, an increase 3.2 percent on June last year, ACI said.
Middle East airports cargo throughput rose 15.0 percent to 124,103 tonnes in contrast to Latin America/ Caribbean airports whose freight traffic volume handled was down four percent at 93,774 tonnes.
African airports recorded the highest growth rate of ACI's cargo-handling regions in the month in cargo traffic growing by 39.0 percent to 44,925 tonnes.
